advisories.finding: An unlisted nested dependency under a listed package closes (node_modules/left-pad/node_modules/evil/index.js with only left-pad and @scope/util listed), while a top-level unlisted package refuses. ResolvedNodeModulesLayoutV1 is one row per installed package directory the resolver may read, so the outermost node_modules segment masks a deeper installed package, the same masking class as the VCS defect. Identity section 3's literal 'inside a package directory' is satisfied and section 3 disclaims proving every read package is listed, so this is ambiguous rather than a clear owner violation.
advisories.suggestion: Resolve the package directory at the innermost node_modules segment (two segments for a scope), or state explicitly that nested installed packages are covered by the enclosing listed directory; discovery pruning unchanged either way.
